paper_title: Less, but Better Efficient Multilingual Expansion for LLMs via   Layer-wise Mixture-of-Experts
caption: The similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the similarity of HSAs in different languages across various layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B, comparing four distinct language pairs. 
The X-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 22, with a linear scale and uniform intervals of 2. 
The Y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and spans from 0.00 to 0.45, also with a linear scale, and uniform intervals of 0.05.

The graph displays four lines, each representing a different language pair: en&en (red, solid line), en&es (blue, solid line), en&el (green, solid line), and en&bn (purple, solid line). 
The red line (en&en) starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, fluctuates with a peak of around 0.28 at layer 6, decreases to about 0.15 at layer 10, and then gradually declines to around 0.08 at layer 20 before sharply rising to 0.45 at layer 22. 
The blue line (en&es) begins at roughly 0.03 at layer 0, mirrors the red line's pattern but at slightly lower values, peaking at about 0.25 at layer 6, and reaching 0.43 at layer 22. 
The green line (en&el) and purple line (en&bn) follow similar patterns to the blue line but at lower similarity values, both reaching their maximum at layer 6 with approximately 0.15 and 0.14 respectively, and then rising to around 0.32 and 0.35 at layer 22.

The graph effectively visualizes the comparative similarity trends across different language pairs and layers, highlighting the variations and peak similarities at specific layers.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the similarity of HSAs in different languages across various layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B. The x-axis, labeled 'Layer', has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22 with a tick label interval of 2. The y-axis, labeled 'Similarity', also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45 with a tick label interval of 0.05. Four lines are plotted: 'en&en' in red, solid line style, starts at 0.05 at layer 0, peaks at 0.27 at layer 6, and ends at 0.43 at layer 22; 'en&es' in blue, solid line style, starts at 0.04 at layer 0, peaks at 0.25 at layer 6, and ends at 0.37 at layer 22; 'en&el' in green, solid line style, starts at 0.03 at layer 0, peaks at 0.14 at layer 12, and ends at 0.29 at layer 22; 'en&bn' in purple, solid line style, starts at 0.02 at layer 0, peaks at 0.15 at layer 12, and ends at 0.32 at layer 22. All lines generally exhibit an initial increase, followed by a decline, and then a sharp rise at the final layer.
